content.title: Review spec: user-docs (quality perspective)
content.description:
Review the draft spec at .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

Analyze from a documentation quality and testability perspective. Comment with:
- Completeness of the 8 proposed sections — any gaps?
- Are the acceptance criteria testable and complete?
- Documentation quality: is the writing guidelines section sufficient?
- Edge cases: any features not covered? Any CLI commands missing?
- Consistency: do the proposed sections cover the full feature set?

Do NOT implement — only analyze and comment.
